issueTitle: A useful agent starts with a clear workflow
subtitle: Fictional stories for a local rendering demonstration.
introHook: This sample edition shows how structured content becomes a readable newsletter. The companies and releases below are fictional.

sections.heading: Harbor Tools adds a review queue
sections.body:
Harbor Tools is a fictional company. Its sample release illustrates a simple product decision: put a draft in front of the operator before anything moves forward.

### Why it matters
A clear review step makes the next action visible. This is demonstration content, not a reported release.
sections.soWhat: The workflow matters alongside the model output.

sections.heading: A short request becomes a consistent draft
sections.body: A fictional operator asks for a short summary. The agent carries context, returns structured content, and the application handles presentation. This sample does not invoke a model or connect to a business.
sections.soWhat: Consistent rendering keeps each edition readable.
sections.takeaway: Keep business rules in the application.

agentBasics: It gives application code a predictable shape to validate and render. A shape alone does not prove the facts are correct.
tryThisWeek: Write down the inputs, output, and approval step for one repetitive task.
cta: Inspect the code and run the local preview.
